content: मुक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [मुच्-क्त] .²1 Loosened, relaxed, slackened. .²2 Set free, liberated, relaxed. .²3 Abandoned, left, given up, set aside, taken off. .²4 Thrown, cast, discharged, hurled. .²5 Fallen down, dropped down from; विदन्ति मार्गं नखरन्ध्रमुक्तैर्मुक्ताफलैः <ls>Ku. 1. 6</ls>. .²6 Drooping, unnerved; मुक्तैरवयवैरशयिषि <ls>Dk.</ls> .²7 Given, bestowed. .²8 Sent forth, emitted. .²9 Finally saved or emancipated. .²10 Ejected, spit out. .²11 Deprived. .²12 Absolved or emancipated (from sin or worldly existence); see मुच् also. .²13 Opened, blown (as a flower); मुक्तपुष्पावकीर्णेन (शोभिता) <ls>Rām. 5. 1. 8</ls>. .²14 Set up, established (प्रवर्तित); स दण्डो विधिवन्मुक्तः <ls>Rām. 7. 79. 9</ls>. .{@-क्तः@} One who is finally emancipated from the bonds of worldly existence, one who has renounced all worldly attachments and secured final beatitude, an absolved saint; सुभाषितेन गीतेन युवतीनां च लीलया . मनो न भिद्यते यस्य स वै मुक्तोऽथवा पशुः .. <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .{@-क्तम्@} The spirit released from worldly existence.
